{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''unidentified club''' operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]]. The establishment featured dark walls decorated with [[Hologram/Legends|holos]] advertising various brands of [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]], with the advertisements promising romance, social success, and wealth to patrons who chose the correct beverage. It had a cavernous main room containing numerous tables, as well as a large stage where dancers entertained the crowd. The club also employed a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Unidentified Chadra-Fan hostess|hostess]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] visited the club with four [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] to meet [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Hachat, who was secretly [[Garik Loran]] of [[Wraith Squadron]] in disguise, to discuss a possible partnership to recover treasure from [[The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes]]. When Teradoc attempted to double cross Hachat by abducting him for [[Interrogation (Imperial Intelligence)|interrogation]], Hachat gave a signal and the other undercover Wraiths, who were working various jobs throughout the club, sprang into action. After a brief skirmish, the Wraiths escaped with [[Mulus Cheems]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] specializing in crystalline materials whom Teradoc had brought to analyze a sample of the treasure that Hachat provided.<ref name="MK" />
